events.what_it_is: ASICS' limited-time SportStyle shop with exclusive sneaker colorways, collaborative styles and on-site customization.
events.what_is_free: Public entry is free. ASICS advertises a complimentary charm bar for sneaker customization; merchandise itself is retail.
events.caveats: The official ASICS page confirms the shop remains open through September 15 from 10 AM–7 PM. The complimentary charm bar is an experience benefit; products are sold separately.
events.practical_notes: Final day is Tuesday, September 15, 10 AM–7 PM at 15 E 40th Street. No RSVP requirement is published.

events.event_name: The Nitro Bar × Reese's Pumpkins Pop-Up
events.address: Astor Place Plaza, 26 Astor Pl, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A two-day Reese's and The Nitro Bar coffee-truck pop-up debuting the limited-time Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Latte ahead of The Nitro Bar's planned NYC expansion.
events.what_is_free: Current event coverage advertises up to 1,000 complimentary Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Lattes per day, each with a recipe card and Reese's Pumpkins; the first 100 guests each day are advertised to receive a limited-edition koozie.
events.caveats: The pop-up runs September 14–15 and promotional inventory is limited. Current sources describe free distribution while supplies last; no RSVP requirement is stated.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 11 AM–5 PM at Astor Place Plaza, 26 Astor Place. Walk in; arrive early because daily quantities are capped.

events.address: Columbia University campus, Broadway & W 116th St, New York, NY 10027
events.what_it_is: A Goodnotes back-to-school campus stop with free specialty coffee, a photo booth, live DJ and merch giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Goodnotes advertises free specialty coffee, a photo booth, live DJ and free merchandise while supplies last; current event listings say the first 100 guests receive free coffee and early guests can receive an additional limited-edition gift.
events.caveats: Goodnotes' official tour page provides an RSVP path and also frames the stop as something students can stop by for. The verified sources do not establish that advance registration is mandatory, so RSVP is treated as optional. Merchandise and coffee are limited.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 1–4 PM at Columbia. The official Goodnotes tour page contains the Columbia RSVP link; arrive early for limited giveaways.

events.event_name: Levi's Wear Longer Project × The New York Sewing Center
events.brand: Levi's × The New York Sewing Center
events.address: The New York Sewing Center, 246 W 38th St Suite 9A, New York, NY 10018
events.what_it_is: A hands-on Levi's Wear Longer Project workshop teaching teens how to repair, refresh and personalize a favorite garment.
events.what_is_free: The workshop itself is free and ticketed for teens ages 14–18.
events.caveats: This is restricted to teens ages 14–18 and advance registration is required. The current verified event page does not expose the exact registration URL, so the listing keeps the requirement visible rather than inventing a ticket link.
events.practical_notes: Wednesday, September 16 from 4–6 PM at The New York Sewing Center. Registration is required; check the source and the Sewing Center's Garment District kids one-day classes for the current reservation path.

events.event_name: National Voter Registration Day NYC Block Party
events.address: LaGuardia Pl between W 4th St and W 3rd St, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: HeadCount's nonpartisan National Voter Registration Day block party with live music, civic organizations, brand activations, art and voter-registration support.
events.what_is_free: Current sources advertise free public participation, brand freebies and chocolate; specific giveaway quantities are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: The event is nonpartisan and open to the public. The more specific current location is LaGuardia Place between West 4th and West 3rd Streets, adjacent to Washington Square Park, rather than the park interior itself.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 10 AM–6 PM on LaGuardia Place between W 4th and W 3rd Streets. No RSVP requirement is published.
